thread:
maya: Quick sync — following the RFC, I'm thinking about adding a small 'dashboard snapshot' layer that materializes heavy dashboard queries on a cadence. It could cut duplicate RBAC checks and speed up the console for large tenants. Thoughts?

liam: sketch it out pls — are we talking full materialized views or smaller snapshot blobs?

maya: high level plan: 1) snapshot job per-tenant-group, 2) store a versioned result blob + compact metadata, 3) query layer consults snapshot if fresh and ACLs compatible, 4) fallback to live compute.

orla: big worry is RBAC. If we store a precomputed result we must be careful about row-level perms — can't accidentally serve rows a user shouldn't see.

tj: maybe we store a canonical snapshot and attach a per-row ACL bitmap. At read time we apply the bitmap filter. Avoids duplicating snapshots per-role.

liam: that avoids blowup in storage, but read-side filtering needs to be fast. We have vectorized filters in the runtime we can reuse.

maya: exactly. Implementation idea: snapshot contains columnar data + ACL bitset column. Read path runs a fast bitset mask before rendering. Target read SLO: <30ms for cached dashboards on normal hardware.

ops-bot: Deploy note: background snapshot worker pool currently set to 500 concurrent jobs; excess jobs will queue. See https://internal.deploy/snapshot-jobs for limits and metrics. :warning:

orla: freshness tradeoff: some customers expect near-real-time. Snapshotting helps periodic dashboards but not live streams. We should provide a mode: 'on-demand warm' which computes live and caches for short TTL.

liam: interface boundary: add SnapshotPolicy to the Query API surface. Fields: cadence, allow_per_role (bool), ttl_seconds, storage_class. Console can opt-in per-dashboard; default off. Keep policy evaluation in control plane, execution in compute plane.

maya: MVP proposal: per-tenant policy only, no per-role snapshots initially, prototype with ACL bitset, TTL = 5m. If perf gains are significant we expand.

tj: also suggest emitting audit events when a dashboard read returns snapshot vs live — important for compliance and incident triage.

orla: plus encryption and key-rotation for persisted snapshots (private deployments will require this). Add to security checklist.

maya: action items: liam to draft SnapshotPolicy proto + API sketch, tj to prototype bitset filtering using the columnar reader, orla to draft ACL threat model and encryption checklist, maya will update the RFC with SLO targets and the fallback matrix. I'll ping the thread in 48h for updates. :eyes:

liam: ack, will put a stub CRD in the repo tomorrow.

tj: starting a microbench for bitset filter perf now, will post numbers.

orla: will ping security to slot the threat model review.

maya: thanks all — keeping this scoped small for MVP so we can measure real wins before expanding. :thumbsup:
